title: Add internal benchmark results API endpoint for marketing site ingestion
author: Logan Wright
description: Context: For the public benchmark report launch, the marketing site needs a reliable way to fetch versioned benchmark artifacts (JSON) without exposing raw object store paths or internal run identifiers. This PR adds an internal service endpoint that returns the latest (or pinned) benchmark dataset for the web experience and enforces allowlisted auth. Summary of changes: (1) Add `GET /internal/benchmarks/results` endpoint in `benchmark-results-service` that serves a precomputed JSON bundle (schema-versioned) from object storage via a cache layer. (2) Add service-to-service authentication: requests must include `X-Redwood-Internal-Token` (rotating secret) OR `Authorization: Bearer <svc_jwt>` depending on caller environment; the marketing web backend will use svc_jwt in prod, token in dev/staging. (3) Add caching and conditional requests: Redis cache with 5m TTL + ETag support; if the upstream artifact version matches, return 304. (4) Add redaction guardrails: response is validated against the public schema and stripped of internal fields (runner hostnames, internal fleet IDs, raw trace IDs). (5) Add observability: latency, cache hit rate, bytes served, 4xx/5xx by reason, and structured logs with request_id. Why now: The docs PRs for the interactive benchmark page need a stable ingestion path (and we want to avoid the marketing site directly reading from storage). Security notes: endpoint is not exposed publicly; it is behind internal ingress + allowlisted caller identity. Additionally, response payload is constrained to the public schema and has a hard size limit to prevent accidental leak of raw logs. Testing: unit tests for auth modes, ETag handling, cache behavior, and schema validation; integration test in CI that loads a fixture artifact and asserts redaction. Rollout: ship behind feature flag `benchmarks_results_api_enabled` default OFF; enable in staging once docs site is ready; production enable coordinated with PMM + SRE. Follow-ups: Add rate limiting at ingress (tracked in ENG-18610) and ensure artifact publisher writes `latest.json` + `manifest.json` in the expected location (ENG-18477).
commits: benchmarks/results: introduce ResultsStore abstraction (object storage + redis cache)
api: add /internal/benchmarks/results handler with schema validation + redaction
auth: support svc_jwt + internal token for internal callers
observability: add metrics + structured logging fields for cache + etag paths
tests: unit + integration fixtures for benchmark bundle response
ci_summary: Buildkite: ✅ build, ✅ unit tests, ✅ lint, ✅ typecheck, ✅ integration (fixture load + redaction), ✅ security scan (deps). One flaky integration run (redis container startup) resolved on rerun.
review_conversation: Felix Schneider (review): Can we support a pinned version param for the web UI so we can roll forward/back without redeploying? Also please confirm we’re not making the marketing site hit this on every page load (cache headers matter here). Logan Wright (author): Added `?version=` optional query. If omitted, uses `latest`. For caching, endpoint returns `Cache-Control: private, max-age=60` and ETag; the web backend will cache in-process and respect 304. Mei Lin (review): Please ensure the payload doesn’t include per-run records; web only needs the aggregated table + metadata. Also add a hard size limit so we don’t accidentally ship raw logs. Logan: Updated bundling contract to only accept `public_bundle` schema; size limit set to 5MB (configurable) and returns 413 if exceeded; added a test using a synthetic oversized payload. Naomi Feldman (security review): Two asks: (1) don’t accept static internal tokens in prod, (2) log reason codes without leaking auth headers. Logan: Implemented env gate: `X-Redwood-Internal-Token` accepted only in dev/staging; prod requires svc_jwt validated against issuer/audience. Logs now include `auth_mode` + `auth_failure_reason` but never include header values. Sean Gallagher (SRE review): Cache stampede risk if Redis is cold and launch traffic spikes. Please add singleflight / in-flight request coalescing per version key, and export cache hit ratio. Logan: Added in-process singleflight keyed by version; added metrics `benchmarks_results_cache_hit_total` and `benchmarks_results_origin_fetch_total`. Henry Cho (product): Make sure the docs reflect what’s internal vs public and that we include disclaimers for consumers of the dataset. Logan: Added internal doc page with clear language: internal endpoint, not for customer use; points to the public methodology + artifact export pipeline. Final approvals: Felix ✅, Mei ✅, Naomi ✅, Sean ✅, Henry ✅.
release_notes: Internal-only: adds benchmark results endpoint for marketing site ingestion with auth + caching. No customer-facing API changes.
post_merge_notes: Enable flag in staging after ENG-18477 publishes first signed-off `public_bundle_v1.json` artifact; coordinate production enablement with SRE on-call during launch week.
